focus: Sky Lagoon playground pacing and return

route_status.proven: The unchanged probe entered Sky Lagoon twice, waited 12 frames after first entry and 4 frames after each build, and verified a single CanvasLayer, no spatial descendants, twelve backdrop tiles, four playground/door target IDs, and synchronous removal of the previous layer before the replacement remained live (scripts/probe_l2_reenter.gd:48-93; receipt log).
route_status.gaps: Probe setup directly sets pearl_count, friend wins, trophies, and plane departure, then invokes entry methods. It does not prove a child-visible route into the playground, toy activation/settle, external activity return, or actual touch/device rendering. The focused probe only exercises re-entry lifecycle.

timing.session_estimate: Not established by the probe. The animation durations above are code constants; total play time depends on travel, child pauses, and selections.

tactile.target_geometry: Playground target radii are slide 118 master px, swing 110, seesaw 110; castle 128 (scripts/arena/sky_lagoon_promenade.gd:549-551, 602-603). Registration records the corresponding footprint metadata (scripts/arena/sky_lagoon_promenade.gd:714+). Actual screen-space sizes depend on camera scale; no device hit test was performed.
tactile.press_response: A tap on a target first focuses it; a second tap on the same target activates it. A tap on open ground clears focus and sets a walk destination (scripts/arena/sky_lagoon_promenade.gd:344-363, 806-827).
tactile.drag_hold_release: Drag cancels navigation/focus and sets a destination (scripts/arena/sky_lagoon_promenade.gd:365-371). In hybrid mode, holding open ground starts following after 0.20 s; reserved UI zones, animals and playground targets are excluded (scripts/arena/sky_lagoon_promenade.gd:889-915). Tap resolution on release is described in code comments; no physical touch tested.
tactile.ownership_cancellation: Movement input cancels navigation/focus (scripts/arena/sky_lagoon_promenade.gd:935-967); explicit cancellation clears walk goal and selected action (scripts/arena/sky_lagoon_promenade.gd:372-380).
tactile.device_status: No rendered Mobile or Lenovo Tab M11 touch/latency evidence in this headless run.

play_appeal.hypothesis: I expect the visible slide, swing, and seesaw to invite a self-chosen short play loop: approach, tap twice, watch Roshan visibly use the selected toy, then move on or repeat. The four authored poses and equipment motion could make each choice feel distinct, while a long automatic action could reduce control for a preschooler.
play_appeal.concrete_appeal_test: On the target tablet, give a child a short uncoached visit with all three toys visible; record whether the child independently approaches and activates more than one, watches or interrupts the full action, returns to a toy, and can leave for the castle without adult prompting. Ask for no numeric fun rating; capture the child's spontaneous words/actions and separate observer interpretation.

play_sequence.wait: 2 frames, skip intro if active, then wait 2 frames (probe setup only)
play_sequence.input: Probe directly grants pearl total, friend wins, trophies, and departed-plane state, then calls _enter_level2(true); no child route is demonstrated (scripts/probe_l2_reenter.gd:48-64).
Observe first constructed stage; probe checks one Canvas layer, 12 tiles, four target IDs and no Node3D descendants (scripts/probe_l2_reenter.gd:64-75).
Probe calls _enter_level2(true) a second time without caller teardown; old layer must be invalid synchronously, new layer unique and target IDs preserved (scripts/probe_l2_reenter.gd:77-85).

play_sequence.wait: Code-path estimate: walk until arrival; speed is 790 master px/s with 28 px arrival radius
play_sequence.input: For a routed playthrough, tap open ground to walk toward a toy; runtime code clears any prior focus and updates route/camera (scripts/arena/sky_lagoon_promenade.gd:344-363, 935-967). Not exercised by L44 probe.

play_sequence.wait: One tap, then one further tap after focus
play_sequence.input: First target tap focuses and labels PLAY; second tap activates toy (scripts/arena/sky_lagoon_promenade.gd:344-363, 820-866). Not exercised by L44 probe.

play_sequence.wait: Up to 5.4-5.8 s action plus 0.34 s settle, per constants
play_sequence.input: Observe four-state Roshan animation and equipment response; after settle, test another toy or walk to the castle. The assigned probe does not test this sequence or return.

observations.title: Re-entry replaces the prior promenade synchronously
evidence: scripts/probe_l2_reenter.gd:64-93; attempt_1/probe.log reports REENTER canvas_first: OK, canvas_rebuild_no_stack: OK, ALL OK
observations.reproduction: The probe builds once, re-enters with _enter_level2(true), and asserts the old root is already invalid and exactly one fresh stage exists.
observations.child_impact: Repeated arrival should not leave stacked input/render stages; actual perceived transition quality remains unobserved.
observations.proposed_repair: No repair indicated by this scoped assertion.
observations.acceptance_test: Keep the existing focused probe passing and add routed/device return evidence before claiming child-facing return acceptance.

observations.title: Assigned probe bypasses the child-visible entry route
evidence: scripts/probe_l2_reenter.gd:57-64 directly writes progression and invokes _enter_level2
scripts/arena/sky_lagoon_promenade.gd:278-294 selects spawn and guidance based on entry state
observations.reproduction: Read probe setup: prerequisite progress is assigned directly before entry; no menu/castle journey is enacted.
observations.child_impact: Whether a preschooler can find and understand the playground from the live game route remains unknown.
observations.proposed_repair: No gameplay repair inferred; gather a routed input session through the intended entry and toy approach.
observations.acceptance_test: Record the exact live route and visible/voice cues from entry through first toy, then verify on-device with a non-reading child.

observations.title: Tap-to-focus then tap-to-play adds an extra selection step
observations.reproduction: Tap a target once: _focus sets its id. Tap same target again: _activate runs. A new target or open-ground tap replaces/clears the focus.
observations.child_impact: The repeated tap may provide a clear deliberate choice, or may be mistaken for a missed first tap; child comprehension is unverified.
observations.proposed_repair: Keep as an explicit usability question until routed child observation identifies confusion; do not change based on code inspection alone.
observations.acceptance_test: Observe whether a child notices the selected cue and performs the second tap without adult prompting; include a nearby toy switch and open-ground cancellation trial.

observations.title: Toy actions are long and temporarily suppress other touches
observations.reproduction: Select a playground target twice to start its 5.4-5.8 second action; while lagoon_play_anim is nonempty, handle_touch consumes the input and tick advances the action, followed by a 0.34 second settle.
observations.child_impact: A child cannot immediately switch toys or navigate during the authored action; whether the hold feels rewarding or too passive needs observation.
observations.proposed_repair: Measure child attention/attempted interruption first; consider a safe skip/interrupt only if observed friction is confirmed and preserve a readable settle.
observations.acceptance_test: On device, time toy action and settle from rendered response; observe engagement and recovery when the child taps elsewhere mid-action.

observations.title: Playground targets have generous master-space selection radii
observations.reproduction: Inspect registered radius values: slide 118 px, swing and seesaw 110 px; _target_at resolves the closest target center within each radius.
observations.child_impact: Large touch areas may aid one-finger selection, while overlapping or scaled screen-space footprints could choose an adjacent toy; no actual hand/device evaluation occurred.
observations.proposed_repair: No change suggested absent a reproduced mis-target; compare rendered target footprint and adjacent-object selection on the Tab M11.
observations.acceptance_test: At each supported aspect on the target device, tap visible toy centers and edges with one finger; verify intended target wins and adjacent toys remain independently selectable.

strengths.claim: A fresh build clears previous route/focus/animation state and creates a single true-Canvas stage.
Toy activation snaps Roshan onto the authored first contact pose immediately, avoiding a one-frame old-position flash.
Manual movement cancels the old selected action/navigation promise.

acceptance_gaps: No routed child-input probe for toy approach, focus, activation, completion, exit, or return; probe direct state writes are internal setup only.
Headless scripted run does not establish requested Mobile visuals, one-finger tactile feel, actual Lenovo Tab M11 performance/latency, child comprehension/appeal, or owner acceptance (DL-QA-01..07).
Probe PASS proves only its listed re-entry assertions; it does not verify playground pacing or external-trip return.
